hero.label: The Founding Partner program
hero.title: Help shape the tool Romanian furniture makers actually need.
hero.body: We're not looking for testers for unfinished software. We're looking for furniture makers to build it with us. Join the Founding Partner waitlist for free; when we open subscriptions (the paid Basic plan: nesting, labels, quotes), people on that list get 20% off. Anyone who subscribes later pays full list price.

counter.full: All {total} Founding Partner spots have been claimed.

items.title: Free to join
items.body: You pay nothing to sign up. You're not obliged to buy when we open subscriptions.

items.title: 20% off your subscription
items.body: When we move to paid plans, you get 20% off list price for 6 months from first payment. Anyone who joins later, without a waitlist place, pays full list.

items.title: Your ideas on the development list
items.body: What you tell us is missing in the workshop goes onto a list of possible app developments. We build them when more people in the community want them — not just one workshop.

items.title: Your name on the list
items.body: You're listed among the people who helped build Mobilcab.

items.title: Direct contact
items.body: You talk with the founders (and the other FPs). We notify you personally when we open subscriptions, with list price and your discount.

next.title: What happens after you join
steps: You're on the Founding Partner waitlist — free, in your name.
You use the app like everyone else — full design and cut list, with no export limits; we build nesting, labels and quotes in parallel.
When we open subscriptions (the paid Basic plan), we contact you with list price and your 20% discount. Anyone who subscribes later, without a waitlist place, pays full list.
